description: This file defines REST API endpoints for analytics data related to a code repository platform, including compute functions for daily metrics, and endpoints for retrieving commits, PR merges, active contributors, and recent activity. It heavily interacts with a database using SQL queries, and utilizes FastAPI for routing.

classes.name: AnalyticsComputeRequest
classes.description: Request model for compute analytics endpoint, specifying org, optional repo, and date range.

classes.name: AnalyticsComputeResponse
classes.description: Response model for post-computation results, including counts of rows upserted.

classes.name: DayCountPoint
classes.description: Represents a daily commit count data point.

classes.name: RepoCountPoint
classes.description: Represents a repo's merged PR count and name.

classes.name: RecentActivityItem
classes.description: Data structure representing an activity feed item that joins git events with repo metadata.

classes.name: ActiveContributorsResponse
classes.description: Response model for active contributor count.

methods.name: tuple[datetime,datetime] _utc_dt_range_from_dates( start_date: Optional[date], end_date: Optional[date], )
methods.description: Converts optional start and end dates to UTC datetime range, applying default logic.

methods.name: None _validate_org_repo_scope(org_id: UUID, repo_id: Optional[UUID], db: Session)
methods.description: Validates that a given repo belongs to the specified organization.

methods.name: int _compute_repo_daily(db: Session, *, org_id: UUID, repo_id: Optional[UUID], start_ts: datetime, end_ts: datetime)
methods.description: Calculates and upserts daily repository-specific analytics data from git_events.

methods.name: int _compute_dev_daily(db: Session, *, org_id: UUID, repo_id: Optional[UUID], start_ts: datetime, end_ts: datetime)
methods.description: Calculates and upserts daily developer-specific analytics data from git_events.

methods.name: AnalyticsComputeResponse compute_analytics(req: AnalyticsComputeRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: API endpoint to trigger on-demand computation of analytics data within a date range.

methods.name: List[DayCountPoint] commits_per_day( org_id: UUID = Query(..., description="Organization UUID."), repo_id: Optional[UUID] = Query(default=None, description="Optional repo UUID."), start_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="Start date (inclusive, UTC)."), end_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="End date (exclusive, UTC)."), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Fetches daily commits count, optionally scoped to a specific repo.

methods.name: List[RepoCountPoint] prs_merged_per_repo( org_id: UUID = Query(..., description="Organization UUID."), start_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="Start date (inclusive, UTC)."), end_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="End date (exclusive, UTC)."), limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max repos returned (sorted by merged count desc)."), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves merged PR count per repo in an organization for a date range.

methods.name: ActiveContributorsResponse active_contributors( org_id: UUID = Query(..., description="Organization UUID."), repo_id: Optional[UUID] = Query(default=None, description="Optional repo UUID."), start_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="Start date (inclusive, UTC)."), end_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="End date (exclusive, UTC)."), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Determines count of distinct active contributors over a date range, with fallback to raw git_events.

methods.name: List[RecentActivityItem] recent_activity( org_id: UUID = Query(..., description="Organization UUID."), repo_id: Optional[UUID] = Query(default=None, description="Optional repo UUID."), limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max events returned."), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves recent git events for an organization, joining with repo metadata for dashboard activity feeds.
